title: List of 153 eligible candidates for Final Written Examination for the post of Scientific Officer to be held on August 20, 2017
bodyHtml:
INDIAN PHARMACOPOEIA COMMISSION
MINISTRY OF HEALTH & FAMILY WELFARE
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
SECTOR-23, RAJ NAGAR, GHAZIABAD-201 002

Tel. No. 0120-2783392, 2783400, 2783401, 2783401; Fax: 0120-2783311
 e-mail: ipclab@vsnl.net, Web: www.ipc.gov.in

Subject: Direct recruitment to the post of Scientific Officer (6-UR, 2-OBC and 1-SC)

Attached is the list of 153 eligible candidates, shortlisted on the basis of performance in the Preliminary Qualifying Written Test held on May 14, 2017 at Andhra Education Society- Dr. Durgabai Deshmukh Memorial Senior Secondary School, Deendayal Upadhaya Marg, New Delhi 110002, for Final Written Examination to be held on August 20, 2017 at the same venue. The individual Admit Card are being sent by post and through email to all concerned.

2.The number of shortlisted candidates is fifteen times the numbers of posts in each category. However, in cases where a number of candidates at the bottom of the merit list have obtained the same marks, all of them have been included in the shortlist.
